eventBasics.alternateDates: May 23 or May 29 would also work if needed
eventBasics.venue: Grand Ballroom at The Meridian Hotel, 1250 Market Street, Downtown
eventBasics.accessWindows: Load-in allowed starting 2pm, must be completed by 5:30pm

eventTypeService.eventDescription: Annual Excellence Awards Gala Dinner for TechVision Inc. This is our signature event celebrating employee achievements and company milestones. Atmosphere should be elegant and professional with a celebratory tone. Key executives and their spouses will be in attendance, along with top-performing team members from all departments. We'll have a brief awards ceremony between courses.

contactBilling.decisionMaker: Same - Jennifer Rodriguez has final approval

priorities.priority1: Exceptional food quality and presentation - This is our premier event and needs to reflect our company's commitment to excellence
priorities.priority2: Precise timing - Awards ceremony is scheduled between courses and cannot be delayed. Service must be on schedule.
priorities.dietaryRestrictions: Approximately 25 vegetarian meals needed, 8-10 gluten-free, 5 vegan, 2 guests with shellfish allergies, 1 guest with severe nut allergy. Will provide final detailed list 2 weeks before event.
priorities.allergyCoordinator: Jennifer Rodriguez (myself) - I maintain the master guest list and will coordinate with attendees
priorities.specialRequests: We would like tasteful table settings that complement our corporate colors (navy blue and silver). We will provide centerpieces but need your recommendation on linens. Also exploring the possibility of a signature cocktail for the reception hour - perhaps something with our logo or theme? We'll have AV team on-site for the awards presentation. Will need coordination for timing when servers clear/deliver courses around the presentations.

internalAssessment.venueComplexity: Established partnership venue - The Meridian. Full kitchen facilities available. Loading dock access confirmed. Power and utilities are excellent. Venue coordinator Sarah is very experienced and easy to work with. Note: Venue requires COI with $2M liability naming them as additional insured.
internalAssessment.riskFlags: Low risk overall. TechVision is a well-established Fortune 500 company with excellent payment history (past client - catered their holiday party Dec 2023, paid on time, no issues). Large event with high visibility - good portfolio opportunity. Confirmed corporate credit card on file for deposit.

marketing.referralDetails: TechVision worked with us for their holiday party in December 2023. Jennifer reached out directly via email mentioning the excellent experience and requesting a quote for this larger gala event.

metadata.notes: HIGH PRIORITY - Past client with excellent experience. Fast-track qualification. Recommend scheduling discovery call within 24 hours. Consider offering premium package with signature cocktail option and upgraded presentation. This could become annual repeat business.
